calls_labeled.title: Pricing: quote vs RingHawk renewal counter

labeler: projects-2f (Claude Code build session), judged claim-by-claim against samples/DEAL-STATE.md's planted-traps answer key and the raw transcript utterances in each bundle
review_status: DRAFT — machine-labeled with documented, checkable rationale per claim; TASKBOARD.md lists this row as "Sourav + drafting agent" — pending Sourav's spot-check/sign-off. Every rationale below cites the exact evidence quote and DEAL-STATE trap (where applicable) so a reviewer can verify or overturn each label without re-doing the work.
precision_formula: precision = shipped_correct / shipped_total, where 'shipped' = claims with status:'verified' (the ones the pipeline actually asserts as fact to the user). Claims the pipeline demoted (status:'uncorroborated'/'segment_corrected') or blocked (status:'blocked_injection') are NOT in the denominator — they were never shipped as a fact — but are still labeled below (as correctly_caught_fake / correctly_blocked) so the demotion mechanism itself is evidenced, per the task's explicit instruction that the planted fake claim counts as a correctly-caught true negative, not as a shipped error.

traps_covered: negation trap (call 01, utterance 10: 'we do not have a budget problem ... it's a trust problem') — resolved CORRECTLY by pricing-0 and objections-0
coreference trap (call 01, utterance 12: 'it's just too expensive' referring to the RingHawk renewal, not CallForge) — resolved CORRECTLY by pricing-1
reported-speech trap (call 03, utterance 9: 'the old vendor told us ... porting numbers takes months') — resolved CORRECTLY by objections-1 (attributed as secondhand, not asserted as fact)

planted FAKE claim (call 03, pricing-4: 'Rep agreed to match RingHawk's twenty two renewal price') — CORRECTLY CAUGHT: quote 'i can match their twenty two if you commit today' does not occur in utterance 6 or anywhere in the transcript; pipeline demoted it to status:'uncorroborated' rather than shipping it as verified

labels.rationale: STRETCH, flagged honestly. Utterance 16 is the buyer agreeing to a DEMO time ('do it thursday' = schedule the demo), not a go-live/deployment date. This is a TRUE NEGATIVE, scored as correctly-caught per the task's explicit instruction, and is NOT counted in the shipped precision denominator because it was never shipped as a fact.
